Marsiva MR-US1K Energy Efficient 1kVA Online UPS

The Marsiva MR-US1K Energy Efficient 1kVA Online UPS provides exceptional power protection and reliability for your critical systems. Designed for both home offices and small businesses, this Online UPS ensures uninterrupted, clean, and stable power, safeguarding sensitive equipment like computers, servers, network devices, and medical equipment.

Built with true double-conversion technology, the Marsiva MR-US1K continuously filters and converts incoming AC power to DC, and then back to AC, offering a zero transfer time to ensure no disruption in power supply. Its energy-efficient design not only reduces energy consumption but also extends battery life, providing long-term savings and improved performance.


Key Features:

1kVA / 800W power capacity, ideal for small offices and home use

True Double Conversion Technology for continuous clean power

Zero Transfer Time for seamless power switching during outages

Energy-Efficient Design to lower power consumption and extend battery life

Full Protection: Overload, short circuit, and surge protection

LCD Display for real-time status monitoring and alerts

Compact Design perfect for home and office environments

Extended Battery Runtime: Provides ample backup time during outages

Quiet Operation for a noise-free experience in sensitive environments
